ROW.COLUMN: (IML/CU) Change In Behavior: Inactive to Active Customers

Money launderers may open accounts and initially engage in a small number of transactions or keep their accounts dormant until they are seasoned and presumably less risky. They then accelerate the activity through their accounts to enable them to move funds and provide the appearance of legitimacy. This scenario detects increased activity by a customer after a specified period of inactivity and after a specified period since the customer's information was last updated (last due diligence). The activity monitored includes wire transactions, trades, and journals between unrelated accounts. It excludes interest and dividends as activity. In addition to the inactive to active behavior, the scenario needs to check the activity including wire transactions to high-risk geography, wire transactions with changes in standing instructions, wire transactions to third parties, journals between unrelated accounts, or the focal customer is a high-risk entity to generate an alert.

--OFSAABD-3919 with All_Cust as (SELECT c.CUST_INTRL_ID, c.CUST_SEQ_ID, c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB, count (distinct a.ACCT_INTRL_ID) as Tot_Acct_Ct, (select c.clndr_dt from @MANTAS@.KDD_cal c where c.clndr_day_age = 0 and c.clndr_nm = 'SYSCAL') - max(a.acct_open_dt) as d_Most_Recent_Open_Date, NVL(((select k.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') - max(c.FNCL_PRFL_LAST_UPDT_DT)), 0) as d_Days_Last_Due_Dilligence FROM @MINER@.ACCT a, @MINER@.CUST c WHERE a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID = c.CUST_INTRL_ID and c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 and (@All_Jurisdictions_Fl = 'Y' OR c.JRSDCN_CD IN (@Jrsdn_Code_List)) GROUP BY c.CUST_INTRL_ID, c.CUST_SEQ_ID, c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB HAVING (select c.clndr_dt from @MANTAS@.KDD_cal c where c.clndr_day_age = 0 and c.clndr_nm = 'SYSCAL') - max(a.acct_open_dt) >= @Min_Due_Diligence_Dt OR NVL(((select k.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') - max(c.FNCL_PRFL_LAST_UPDT_DT)), 0) >= @Min_Due_Diligence_Dt )
select 1 as Acct_Ct, ac.ACCT_INTRL_ID, cu.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB, cu.CUST_INTRL_ID, cu.CUST_SEQ_ID, asm.HRG_WIRE_TRXN_IN_CT + asm.HRG_WIRE_TRXN_OUT_CT as d_Hrg_Wire_Trxn_Ct, --Bug#21120653 COALESCE(iasm.STNDG_INSTN_CHG_CT,0) as d_Stndg_Instn_Chg_Ct, asm.THRD_PARTY_WIRE_IN_CT + asm.THRD_PARTY_WIRES_OUT_CT as d_Thrd_Party_Wire_Ct, --Bug#21120653 asm.TOT_SELL_AM + asm.TOT_BUY_AM as d_Trade_Am, asm.INTER_HH_JRNL_IN_AM + asm.INTER_HH_JRNL_OUT_AM as d_Unrltd_Jrnl_Am, asm.INTER_HH_JRNL_IN_CT + asm.INTER_HH_JRNL_OUT_CT as d_Unrltd_Jrnl_Ct, asm.WIRE_TRXN_IN_AM + asm.WIRE_TRXN_OUT_AM as d_Wire_Trxn_Am, asm.WIRE_TRXN_IN_CT + asm.WIRE_TRXN_OUT_CT as d_Wire_Trxn_Ct from @MINER@.ACCT ac inner join All_Cust cu on ac.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID = cu.CUST_INTRL_ID inner join @MINER@.ACCT_SMRY_MNTH asm on ac.ACCT_INTRL_ID = asm.ACCT_INTRL_ID --Bug#21120653 left outer join ( select ias.ACCT_INTRL_ID, ias.STNDG_INSTN_CHG_CT from @MINER@.INSTL_ACCT_SMRY_MNTH ias where ias.last_updt_dt = (select k.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') and ias.MNTH_SMRY_START_DT = (select f_trunc_date(k.CLNDR_DT, 'MM') from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') ) iasm on ac.ACCT_INTRL_ID = iasm.ACCT_INTRL_ID
where --Consider All Accounts = 'N' @All_Accts_Fl = 'N' --there is activity in the current month and asm.MNTH_SMRY_START_DT = (select f_trunc_date(k.CLNDR_DT, 'MM') from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where 'SYSCAL') --there are no ACCT_SMRY_MNTH records in the inactivity window (excluding current month)-- and not exists (select 'x' from @MINER@.ACCT_SMRY_MNTH asm1, @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL cal1 where > 0 or (asm.THRD_PARTY_WIRE_IN_CT + asm.THRD_PARTY_WIRES_OUT_CT) > 0 or (asm.HRG_WIRE_TRXN_IN_CT + asm.HRG_WIRE_TRXN_OUT_CT) > 0 or (asm.INTER_HH_JRNL_IN_CT + asm.INTER_HH_JRNL_OUT_CT) > 0 or ( (select ac.ACCT_INTRL_ID, cu.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB, cu.CUST_INTRL_ID, cu.CUST_SEQ_ID, cu.Tot_Acct_Ct, asm.HRG_WIRE_TRXN_IN_CT + asm.HRG_WIRE_TRXN_OUT_CT as d_Hrg_Wire_Trxn_Ct, --Bug#21120653 COALESCE(iasm.STNDG_INSTN_CHG_CT,0) as d_Stndg_Instn_Chg_Ct, asm.THRD_PARTY_WIRE_IN_CT + asm.THRD_PARTY_WIRES_OUT_CT as d_Thrd_Party_Wire_Ct, --Bug#21120653 asm.TOT_SELL_AM + asm.TOT_BUY_AM as d_Trade_Am, asm.INTER_HH_JRNL_IN_AM + asm.INTER_HH_JRNL_OUT_AM as d_Unrltd_Jrnl_Am, asm.INTER_HH_JRNL_IN_CT + asm.INTER_HH_JRNL_OUT_CT as d_Unrltd_Jrnl_Ct, asm.WIRE_TRXN_IN_AM + asm.WIRE_TRXN_OUT_AM as d_Wire_Trxn_Am, asm.WIRE_TRXN_IN_CT + asm.WIRE_TRXN_OUT_CT as d_Wire_Trxn_Ct from @MINER@.ACCT ac inner join All_Cust cu on ac.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID = cu.CUST_INTRL_ID inner join @MINER@.ACCT_SMRY_MNTH asm on ac.ACCT_INTRL_ID = asm.ACCT_INTRL_ID --Bug#21120653 left outer join ( select ias.ACCT_INTRL_ID, ias.STNDG_INSTN_CHG_CT from @MINER@.INSTL_ACCT_SMRY_MNTH ias where ias.last_updt_dt = (select k.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') and ias.MNTH_SMRY_START_DT = (select f_trunc_date(k.CLNDR_DT, 'MM') from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') ) iasm on ac.ACCT_INTRL_ID = iasm.ACCT_INTRL_ID

-- soodt on 15th March 2011: Replaced 'Data_Dump_Dt' to 'Last_Data_Dump_Dt' for "ACCT_TRADE_SMRY_DAILY" Table as per PR#46779 --Bug#21120653 sagafono May 2015 redesign to left outer join for all summary daily tables select ac.ACCT_SEQ_ID, ac.ACCT_INTRL_ID, ac.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID, COALESCE(atx.d_Hrg_Wire_Trxn_Ct,0) as d_Hrg_Wire_Trxn_Ct , COALESCE(iad.STNDG_INSTN_CHG_CT,0) as d_Stndg_Instn_Chg_Ct, COALESCE(atx.d_Thrd_Party_Wire_Ct,0) as d_Thrd_Party_Wire_Ct, COALESCE(atd.d_Trade_Am,0) as d_Trade_Am, COALESCE(atx.d_Unrltd_Jrnl_Am,0) as d_Unrltd_Jrnl_Am, COALESCE(atx.d_Unrltd_Jrnl_Ct,0) as d_Unrltd_Jrnl_Ct, COALESCE(atx.d_Wire_Trxn_Am,0) as d_Wire_Trxn_Am, COALESCE(atx.d_Wire_Trxn_Ct,0) as d_Wire_Trxn_Ct from @MINER@.ACCT ac inner join @MINER@.CUST cu on ac.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID = cu.CUST_INTRL_ID left outer join ( select atx.ACCT_INTRL_ID, atx.HRG_WIRE_TRXN_IN_CT + atx.HRG_WIRE_TRXN_OUT_CT as d_Hrg_Wire_Trxn_Ct, atx.THRD_PARTY_WIRE_IN_CT + atx.THRD_PARTY_WIRES_OUT_CT as d_Thrd_Party_Wire_Ct, atx.INTER_HH_JRNL_IN_AM + atx.INTER_HH_JRNL_OUT_AM as d_Unrltd_Jrnl_Am, atx.INTER_HH_JRNL_IN_CT + atx.INTER_HH_JRNL_OUT_CT as d_Unrltd_Jrnl_Ct, atx.WIRE_TRXN_IN_AM + atx.WIRE_TRXN_OUT_AM as d_Wire_Trxn_Am, atx.WIRE_TRXN_IN_CT + atx.WIRE_TRXN_OUT_CT as d_Wire_Trxn_Ct from @MINER@.ACCT_TRXN_SMRY_DAILY atx where atx.DATA_DUMP_DT = (select k.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') ) atx on ac.ACCT_INTRL_ID = atx.ACCT_INTRL_ID
left outer join ( select atd.ACCT_INTRL_ID, atd.TOT_SELL_AM + atd.TOT_BUY_AM as d_Trade_Am from @MINER@.ACCT_TRADE_SMRY_DAILY atd where atd.LAST_DATA_DUMP_DT = (select k.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') ) atd on ac.ACCT_INTRL_ID = atd.ACCT_INTRL_ID

where ac.MANTAS_ACCT_HOLDR_TYPE_CD in ('CI') and (@All_Acct_Type_Fl = 'Y' OR ac.ACCT_TYPE1_CD IN (@Incl_Acct_Type_Lst)) and cu.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 and (@All_Jurisdictions_Fl = 'Y' OR cu.JRSDCN_CD IN (@Jrsdn_Code_List)) --there are no ACCT_SMRY_MNTH records in the inactivity window (excluding current month)-- and not exists (select 'x' from @MINER@.ACCT_SMRY_MNTH asm1, @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL cal1 where cal1.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and cal1.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and asm1.MNTH_SMRY_START_DT >= add_months(f_trunc_date(cal1.CLNDR_DT, 'MM'), -@Min_Mnth_Inactive) and asm1.MNTH_SMRY_START_DT < f_trunc_date(cal1.CLNDR_DT, 'MM') and ac.ACCT_INTRL_ID = asm1.ACCT_INTRL_ID )

Y: Alert is generated only if all accounts of the customer were inactive for the number of months mentioned in the Minimum Months Inactive threshold. N: Alert is generated if any account of the customer was inactive for the number of months mentioned in the Minimum Months Inactive threshold. Note: By setting this parameter to Y, the logic will consider the customer only if ALL the associated accounts were inactive in the prior months mentioned in the Minimum Months Inactive threshold. Alerts will not be generated for individual accounts of the customer that were inactive and then made active in the current month.
